architecture_choices.different_fitting_open_weight: The materially different 14B family passed protocol and one coding task but failed sustained occupied-host fit on the harder UI workflow. Previously screened GLM-4.7-Flash 3-bit failed answer/tool protocol; larger 27B/35B candidates also hit resource limits. No tested challenger passes the required combination of native tooling, accepted UI work and host fit.
architecture_choices.stronger_shorter_context: The 14B profile used 49K instead of the installed 9B's configured 96K; its accepted Task03 result does not offset the guarded UI abort and failed browser diagnostics. The interrupted UI root session's observed step prompts peaked below 19K tokens, so lowering the nominal context cap is not established as a memory cure. No shorter-context stronger profile is promoted.
architecture_choices.optional_external_frontier: An external frontier provider would require explicit user selection and possibly cost. The user has disallowed paid-provider use, the OpenCode free route previously returned HTTP 403, and no external provider was configured or used in these trials.
architecture_choices.truthful_v1_scope: The installed 9B plus acceptance-controller and requirement-evidence development experiments each achieved 0/3 independent autonomous UI acceptance. This is a measured ceiling on the tested local workflow, not proof that the model can never succeed. Until repeatable accepted work is demonstrated, KRYN's supported claim is supervised local coding; autonomous/frontier-equivalent claims and public release remain paused.
